content:
Irene: deploybot aborted promote for release/2026-05-12 (commit c7d8e9). Staging integration failed repeatedly with cache read timeouts from the CI cache. tagging @vik @sasha for decision.

deploybot: Promotion attempt at 1732468000 failed. Reason: ci/staging/integration#409 errors: repeated cache read timeout / cache miss cascade. Logs: https://ci.internal/job/409 (restricted).

Vik: looking at the job: multiple integration shards failed pulling cached fixtures; the cache proxy returned 504s for ~3m starting at 1732467930. The tests then fell back to remote fetch and timed out.

Sasha: change window in ~40m. Options: 1) pin to last-prod (fast), 2) delay 30m and re-run after cache proxy patch, 3) promote with reduced parallelism (risky). Product preference?

Product-bot: Product ok with a short delay up to 30m to avoid pinning, but needs a firm cutoff and customer-facing note if we delay.

Irene: agree on a 30m timebox. If cache proxy not healthy by cutoff, pin to sha256:prod111. Also open INFR-4210 to investigate cache proxy throttling.

Vik: rolling a quick fix to the cache proxy to increase connection pool and reduce upstream retries: `infra/cache-proxy bump-pool --conn 200`. Will restart one pod at a time and watch 5m.

deploybot: Promote placed on hold until 1732469800 per request 'hold-cache-proxy-restart'. Will auto-abort at cutoff.

Vik: proxy restart started at 1732468050. Metrics show errors dropped to near-zero by 1732468090. Triggering a re-run of the staging integration job.

deploybot: Re-run job queued: ci/staging/integration#410.

Irene: re-run shows integration passing on 4/5 shards; one shard still flaky with occasional 504s. Suggest run one more time; if still failing by cutoff, pin and then open incident.

Sasha: second re-run passed all shards. Great. Running two fast canaries then we'll promote.

deploybot: canaries passed. Promotion initiated and completed. prod now at sha256:ci-c7d8e9 (promotion ts 1732468128).

Irene: created INFR-4210 to track root cause and follow-ups: add a healthcheck to deploybot's pre-promote flow to query cache-proxy, add alert for sustained 5xxs, and increase mirror fallback for CI. Assigning to Vik.

Vik: will follow up with a small PR to add pre-promote cache-proxy HEAD checks and the connection pool change to infra repo.

Sasha: updating release notes: "brief hold due to CI cache proxy timeouts; restart and pre-promote checks added; follow-up INFR-4210." Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
